answer: In our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is ensured by a novel mechanism where each agent maintains a zephyr-like reputation score, updated at every block's pulse, based on verifiable delay attestations and zero-knowledge proofs. An attacker attempting to forge multiple identities is subject to a stake-slashing matrix, incurring a prohibitively high capital lockup, thereby rendering the attack economically unviable, thus maintaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
